explanation: The theorem gives the iterated commutator derivation x ↦ p*x - x*p applied to x^n, in a noncommutative ring where [p,x]=1, as a descFactorial multiple of x^(n-j) (or 0). It is a thin wrapper over two local lemmas that cover the cases j ≤ n and j > n. In Mathlib, the descFactorial iterate formulas are for Polynomial.derivative (iterate_derivative_X_pow_eq_smul and related) and for iteratedDeriv of powers. Those are about polynomials and analysis, not a commutator derivation in a general ring. A grep of Mathlib/Algebra for descFactorial found only the two polynomial files. Mathlib has no Weyl algebra file. I found no matching declaration.
